args:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /workspace/evidence
printf '%s%s%s%s%s%s%s%s' "$$CONFIG_PART_0" "$$CONFIG_PART_1" "$$CONFIG_PART_2" "$$CONFIG_PART_3" "$$CONFIG_PART_4" "$$CONFIG_PART_5" "$$CONFIG_PART_6" "$$CONFIG_PART_7" | base64 --decode | gzip --decompress > /workspace/evidence/submitted-config.json
printf '%s  %s\n' "$$SUBMITTED_CONFIG_SHA" /workspace/evidence/submitted-config.json | sha256sum -c -
{ uname -a; nproc; cat /etc/os-release; cat /proc/meminfo; if test -f /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max; then cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max; fi; df -h /workspace; if test -f /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max; then cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max; fi; } > /workspace/evidence/environment.txt
export SMALLSORT_DEADLINE_EPOCH=$$(( $$(date +%s) + 1130 - 15 ))
set +e
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s "1130s" bash -ceu 'set -euo pipefail
 export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
 apt-get update
 apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git python3 time
python3 -c '\''import base64,os,pathlib; pathlib.Path('\''\'\'''\''/workspace/source-inputs.json.gz'\''\'\'''\'').write_bytes(base64.b64decode('\''\'\'''\'''\''\'\'''\''.join(os.environ['\''\'\'''\''SOURCE_GROUP_'\''\'\'''\''+str(i)] for i in range(18))))'\''
 printf '\''%s  %s\n'\'' '\''68f9dad4f1ab2488891ce76512fcc5105323887154518a830e4ffb9f76049f95'\'' /workspace/source-inputs.json.gz | sha256sum -c -
 printf '\''%s'\'' "$$SOURCE_RESTORE_BYTES" | base64 --decode | gzip --decompress > /workspace/source-input.py
 python3 /workspace/source-input.py restore --archive /workspace/source-inputs.json.gz --evidence /workspace/evidence
 export EVIDENCE_ROOT=/workspace/evidence
 bash /workspace/infra/research/challenge-8/cloud-build/run-proof.sh "$$LANE"
' > /workspace/evidence/full-stdout.log 2> /workspace/evidence/full-stderr.log
code=$$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$$code" > /workspace/evidence/run-exit.txt
cat /workspace/evidence/full-stdout.log
cat /workspace/evidence/full-stderr.log >&2
exit 0

args:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /workspace/cloudsdk/configurations
printf '[core]\nproject = smallsort-ci\naccount = smallsort-builder@smallsort-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com\n' > /workspace/cloudsdk/configurations/config_smallsort-ci
export CLOUDSDK_CONFIG=/workspace/cloudsdk
printf '%s' "$$PACKAGER_BYTES" | base64 --decode | gzip --decompress > /workspace/package-evidence.py
/usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/bin/python3 /workspace/package-evidence.py --evidence /workspace/evidence --out /workspace/out
prefix="gs://smallsort-ci-evidence-504462351565/cloud-build/$$CLOUD_BUILD_ID"
for file in evidence.tar.gz archive.sha256 summary.json manifest.json files-sha256.json submitted-config.json text-logs-index.json; do
 gcloud --configuration=smallsort-ci --account=smallsort-builder@smallsort-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=smallsort-ci storage cp --if-generation-match=0 "/workspace/out/$$file" "$$prefix/$$file"
done
gcloud --configuration=smallsort-ci --account=smallsort-builder@smallsort-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=smallsort-ci storage cp --recursive --if-generation-match=0 /workspace/out/text-logs "$$prefix/"
/usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/bin/python3 - <<'RECEIPT'
import json,os,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/out')
h=(p/'archive.sha256').read_text().split()[0]
(p/'upload-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'build_id':os.environ['CLOUD_BUILD_ID'],'archive_sha256':h,'uploaded':True,'text_logs_index_sha256':__import__('hashlib').sha256((p/'text-logs-index.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
RECEIPT
gcloud --configuration=smallsort-ci --account=smallsort-builder@smallsort-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=smallsort-ci storage cp --if-generation-match=0 /workspace/out/upload-complete.json "$$prefix/upload-complete.json"
touch /workspace/upload.ok

args:
import json,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/out')
try:
 s=json.loads((p/'summary.json').read_text())
 ok=pathlib.Path('/workspace/upload.ok').is_file() and ((s.get('verification_accepted') is True) or (s.get('smoke_success') is True) or (s.get('diagnostic_complete') is True))
 print('SMALLSORT_FINAL_VERDICT',json.dumps(s,sort_keys=True),'upload_complete=',pathlib.Path('/workspace/upload.ok').is_file(),'verification_accepted=',s.get('verification_accepted'),'diagnostic_complete=',s.get('diagnostic_complete'))
 sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
except Exception as e:
 print('INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE',type(e).__name__,str(e));sys.exit(2)
